pool.text: The Longfellow Bridge opened featuring salt and pepper shakers.
Fenway Park opened as the home of the Boston Red Sox.
The town of Hyde Park was annexed by the city.
The Massachusetts Institute of Technology moved across the river to Cambridge.
A flood of molasses in the North End killed twenty-one people.
Logan International Airport opened on September 8.
The Boston Garden opened.
The Cocoanut Grove nightclub was the site of the deadliest nightclub fire.
The massive Columbia Point public housing complex was built.
The Boston Redevelopment Authority was established to direct urban renewal projects.
A project to improve the historic West End neighborhood was initiated.
Kyoto became an official sister city.
The first Community Health Center in the United States opened.
The Bay State Banner began operation.
Barcelona became an official sister city.
Padua became an official sister city.
Beira became an official sister city.
The Improper Bostonian glossy lifestyle magazine was published.
The Boston Globe was acquired by The New York Times.
Two Chechen Islamist brothers detonated a pair of bombs near the finish line.
